cc:Work.dc:title: Shelf - CardHolder
cc:Work.dc:description:
Shelf for holding (multiple) piles of playing cards / notes
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes CardHolder --thickness 4 --burn 0.15 --sx '60*2:80' --angle 12 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes CardHolder --thickness --burn --sx --angle --reference --labels
